verses.text: Now the priest Pashhur son of Immer, the chief officer in the house of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.
So Pashhur had the prophet Jeremiah beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin, at the house of the LORD.
The next day, when Pashhur released him from the stocks, Jeremiah said to him, "The LORD does not call you Pashhur anymore. Your new name is Terror All Around.

For this is what the LORD says: 'I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends. With your own eyes you will see them die by the swords of their enemies. I will hand all Judah over to the king of Babylon. He will carry them away to Babylon or kill them with the sword.

I will hand over all the riches of this city to their enemies, all its products, all its valuable things, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah. They will take them as plunder and carry them off to Babylon.
And you, Pashhur, and everyone who lives in your house will go into exile in Babylon. There you will die and be buried, you and all your friends to whom you have prophesied lies.'"
LORD, you persuaded me, and I let myself be persuaded. You were stronger than I was, and you won. Now I am laughed at all day long. Everyone makes fun of me.
Whenever I speak, I cry out and shout, "Violence and destruction!" So the word of the LORD has brought me insults and mockery all day long.
But if I say, "I will not mention him or speak anymore in his name," his word is like a fire burning in my heart, shut up in my bones. I am worn out from holding it in. I cannot do it.

I hear many people whispering, "Terror all around! Report him! Let us report him!" All my friends are waiting for me to slip. They say, "Maybe he can be tricked. Then we will defeat him and get our revenge on him."
But the LORD is with me like a mighty warrior. So those who chase after me will stumble and will not win. They will fail and be completely disgraced. Their shame will never be forgotten.
LORD of Armies, you test the righteous and see the heart and the mind. Let me see you pay them back, for I have placed my case in your hands.
Sing to the LORD! Praise the LORD! For he rescues the needy from the hands of the wicked.
Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother gave birth to me never be blessed!
Cursed be the man who brought my father the news and made him very glad, saying, "A son has been born to you!"
May that man be like the towns the LORD destroyed without pity. May he hear cries of pain in the morning and the battle cry at noon,
because he did not kill me in the womb. Then my mother would have been my grave, and her womb would have stayed pregnant forever.
Why did I ever come out of the womb to see trouble and sorrow, and to end my days in shame?
